segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 56 Replenishing Some Sugar

The students of Class Eight were already used to Ying Chanxi's presence.

Especially since the news had spread from Zhu Yufei that the class president of Class One seemed to be Li Luo's younger cousin.

So, it was perfectly logical that Ying Chanxi often appeared in Class Eight to find Li Luo.

Aside from some boys who couldn't help but steal glances at Ying Chanxi, the rest of the class didn't think much of it.

On the contrary, it was Li Luo, carrying a guitar case on his back, who attracted quite a few people to gather around and look on with curiosity.

"Is that a guitar in there?" Zhu Yufei asked curiously. "Class President, you know how to do this too?"

"A little," Li Luo said with a smile. He placed the guitar case on the desk, and seeing the curious looks from the surrounding students, he simply opened it and took the guitar out.

"Holy crap, is this brand a Martin?" Lin Yuan, who was next to them, came closer for a look and immediately exclaimed, "Class President, can I touch it?"

"You can play?" Li Luo asked, raising an eyebrow.

"A little bit, hehe," Lin Yuan rubbed his hands, his face full of anticipation. "I learned for a while before."

"Take it." Li Luo readily handed it over, stuffing it into Lin Yuan's arms for him to play.

Holding the guitar, Lin Yuan's expression immediately became reserved. He leaned against the desk in what he thought was a cool pose, his eyes instinctively glancing over at Hua Xiuxiu. He then lowered his head to focus on the strings and tried to play a few notes.

Fortunately, he did have some real skill. Although he couldn't play as smoothly as Li Luo, he could still manage to play a song.

When the song ended, Zhang Guohuang next to him applauded. "Awesome, Lin Yuan. I didn't realize you had this skill. You can go show it off on the sports field tonight."

Lin Yuan rubbed his nose, feeling a little proud, then handed the guitar back to Li Luo. "The Class President's guitar is high quality. The sound is much better than that junk guitar I have at home."

"Is this guitar very expensive?" asked Xu Yinghuan, who was watching from the side.

"It's a Martin D-series, the classic D28," Yan Zhusheng said. "The market price is around ten to twenty thousand."

"That expensive?!" Lin Yuan had only recognized it as a famous brand but didn't know the price. He'd thought one or two thousand at most.

Upon hearing the specific price, his hands nearly trembled, and he quickly returned the guitar to Li Luo.

When the others around heard the price, their mouths fell open. Their gazes fell on Li Luo as they wondered, was the class president's family that rich?

But when they remembered the free drinks and ice pops from yesterday, they felt it was quite normal after all.

And when Li Luo heard Yan Zhusheng identify the specific brand and price at a glance, he wasn't surprised by her ability, but he did feel a little embarrassed that the guitar was so expensive.

After all, Ying Chanxi had brought it from home. It was originally something of Ying Zhicheng's that was just lying around, hardly ever used, except for that one time he'd brandished it during a drunken fit.

It was said to be a gift from someone else.

In the morning, when Li Luo asked Ying Chanxi if he could bring it to school, she had packed it up for him and carried it to the door, not seeming particularly concerned about it.

Still, now that he knew the price, Li Luo handled the guitar with extra care and quickly put it back into its case and closed the lid. "Let's play it again tonight."

...

In the afternoon, Lin Xiufeng still arrived punctually at the school wall at three o'clock.

However, Li Luo was suddenly called to the office by Kong Junxiang, so he asked Zhu Yufei to help him retrieve the delivery and share it with the students of Class Eight.

Ying Chanxi knew that Lin Xiufeng would be coming again today, so after the drill instructor announced a break, while most of the other students were queuing at the tuck shop, she sat quietly in place and waited.

Qiao Xinyan accompanied her, gazing eagerly at the lively scene over in Class Eight's area. She couldn't help but ask in a small voice, "What about my Little Pudding? Are there any today?"

"Can you have a little more self-respect?" Ying Chanxi retracted her gaze and glanced at her deskmate.

"What's the use of self-respect?" Qiao Xinyan shook her head repeatedly, then asked in confusion, "Isn't your cousin coming over today?"

"I don't think I've seen him." Ying Chanxi looked doubtfully toward Class Eight's area but couldn't spot that familiar figure.

Just then, a voice came from beside them, "Ying Chanxi, I bought you a drink on my way. I'll leave it here for you."

Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan turned their heads at the same time to see Liu Shaowen walking over to them, placing a can of Coke in his hand down in front of Ying Chanxi.

"I'm sorry, I'm on a diet recently, so I don't drink Coke," Ying Chanxi said, shaking her head. "Thank you for the kind thought."

"Huh?" Liu Shaowen froze for a moment. He didn't know whether to leave the Coke or take it back. In the end, he could only ask, "Then I'll go buy you something else?"

"No, no." Ying Chanxi quickly stood up and pulled Qiao Xinyan away. "You can give it to another student. I don't think Jian Zhenyuan went to the tuck shop. You can give the Coke to him."

"Ah? Oh..." Liu Shaowen stood rooted to the spot, watching Ying Chanxi's departing figure. Then he turned his head to look at the vice class president, Jian Zhenyuan, who was sitting on the ground nearby. The corner of his mouth twitched.

"Ahem... Can you finish it?" Jian Zhenyuan didn't know whether to laugh or hold it in. Looking at the Coke in his hand, he was quite tempted. "If you can't, I'll help you drink it."

Liu Shaowen thought for a moment, glanced at the Coke he had intended to give Ying Chanxi, and knew he definitely couldn't finish it all.

But he didn't hand that can over. Instead, he tossed the other can of Coke he had originally kept for himself to Jian Zhenyuan.

Popping the tab of the Coke can, Liu Shaowen took two big gulps, imagining this was the can meant for Ying Chanxi. He finally felt a little comfort in his heart.

"What now?" Liao Hailin asked quietly from the side. "Your 'subtle and nurturing companionship' approach requires the other person to be willing to accept it."

"Nothing ever goes smoothly." Liu Shaowen swallowed the Coke. Because he had drunk too much at once, his throat had a burning, stinging sensation, making him feel as if he had swallowed a mouthful of fresh blood in his sorrow. "School just started. Accumulating goodwill over time is what's most important."

...

Meanwhile, Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan didn't go to the tuck shop. Instead, they went straight to Class Eight's area.

When Zhu Yufei saw Ying Chanxi coming over, he remembered Li Luo's earlier instruction and hurried forward to greet her.

"The Class President said earlier that if you came over, Ying Chanxi, you could take whatever you want."

"Where is he?" Ying Chanxi didn't rush to take any drinks, instead asking strangely, "There isn't a meeting scheduled for this time, is there?"

"Oh, it seems our homeroom teacher needed him for something."

"Is that so." Ying Chanxi nodded, indicating she understood. She then walked over to the few boxes and took two bottles of drinks and two Little Puddings.

"Xixi." Qiao Xinyan looked at the bottle of Coke in her hand and was momentarily lost in thought. "Didn't you say you were on a diet and weren't drinking Coke?"

"Um..." Ying Chanxi paused, then, imitating Li Luo's way of speaking, she spun a tale, "I thought about it again. Military training consumes too much energy. I still need to replenish some sugar."

"...What you say makes so much sense."
